# discord_sku_subscriptions (Data Source)

Lists a user's subscriptions that include an SKU, sorted by ID. Use entitlements, not the subscription status, to decide whether the user has access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_skus" "app" {}

data "discord_sku_subscriptions" "alice" {
  sku_id  = one([for s in data.discord_skus.app.skus : s.id if s.type == "subscription"])
  user_id = var.user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sku_id` (String) ID of the SKU.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user. Discord requires it for bots.

### Optional

- `after` (String) Only return subscriptions with an ID higher than this one, starting with the oldest.
- `before` (String) Only return subscriptions with an ID lower than this one.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of subscriptions to return. Defaults to 50. Discord returns at most 100 per request, so higher limits take several requests.

### Read-Only

- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) Subscriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `canceled_at` (String) When the subscription was canceled, or null.
- `current_period_end` (String) End of the current period.
- `current_period_start` (String) Start of the current period.
- `entitlement_ids` (List of String) IDs of the entitlements the subscription granted.
- `id` (String) Subscription ID.
- `renewal_sku_ids` (List of String) IDs of the SKUs the user will be subscribed to at renewal, or null.
- `sku_ids` (List of String) IDs of the SKUs subscribed to.
- `status` (String) Status: `active`, `inactive`, `ending`.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the subscribed user.
